<!-- The session tabs. Include inside a ::: {.panel-tabset} div; the
including page can add tabs of its own after them. -->

## Sponsored bills

```{r}
fmt_date <- \(d) str_squish(format(d, "%b %e, %Y"))
bill_links <- \(bill_number) lapply(format_bill_link(bill_number, bill_dir_href(ga, up = up)), HTML)
# clean_bill_title() takes one title at a time
short_title <- \(title) map_chr(title, \(t) clean_bill_title(t)$title)

ui_table(
  leg_sponsored_bills |>
    transmute(
      bill = bill_links(bill_number),
      title = short_title(title),
      status = status_desc,
      status_date = fmt_date(status_date),
      role = case_when(
        position == 1 & sponsor_num == 1 ~ "Sole sponsor",
        position == 1 ~ "Primary sponsor",
        position >= 2 ~ "Co-sponsor"
      ),
      sponsor_num
    ),
  labels = c(bill = "Bill", title = "Title", status = "Status", status_date = "Status date",
             role = "Role", sponsor_num = "Sponsors"),
  numeric = "sponsor_num",
  nowrap = c("bill", "status_date"),
  empty = "No sponsored bills this session."
)
```

## Voting record

```{r}
tagList(
  if (has_stats) {
    div(class = "ia-card-sub",
        sprintf("%d floor votes · %.1f%% with party · %.1f%% participation",
                n_floor_votes, 100 * leg_stats$with_party_pct, 100 * leg_stats$participation_rate))
  },
  ui_table(
    leg_votes |>
      arrange(desc(date), desc(roll_call_id)) |>
      transmute(
        bill = bill_links(bill_number),
        title = short_title(title),
        date = fmt_date(date),
        description = simplify_vote_desc(description),
        vote = map(vote_desc, vote_pill)
      ),
    labels = c(bill = "Bill", title = "Title", date = "Date", description = "Vote type", vote = "Vote"),
    nowrap = c("bill", "date"),
    empty = "No floor votes recorded this session."
  )
)
```

## Vote analysis

```{r}
if (nrow(leg_vote_records) == 0) {
  ui_empty("No floor votes to analyze yet.")
} else {
  outcome_breakdown <- leg_vote_records |>
    filter(vote_text %in% c("Yea", "Nay")) |>
    summarize(
      count = n(),
      with_party = sum(vote_with_party == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
      against_party = sum(vote_with_party == FALSE, na.rm = TRUE),
      .by = vote_outcome
    ) |>
    mutate(pct_of_total = sprintf("%.1f%%", count / sum(count) * 100)) |>
    arrange(desc(count))

  against_party <- leg_vote_records |>
    filter(vote_with_party == FALSE) |>
    left_join(bills |> select(bill_id, title), by = "bill_id") |>
    arrange(desc(vote_date)) |>
    transmute(
      bill = bill_links(bill_number),
      title = short_title(title),
      vote_date = fmt_date(vote_date),
      vote_desc = simplify_vote_desc(vote_desc),
      vote = map(vote_text, vote_pill),
      party_position,
      vote_outcome
    )

  tagList(
    h3("Votes by classification"),
    ui_table(
      outcome_breakdown,
      labels = c(vote_outcome = "Vote type", count = "Total", with_party = "With party",
                 against_party = "Against party", pct_of_total = "Share of votes"),
      numeric = c("count", "with_party", "against_party", "pct_of_total")
    ),
    h3("Votes against party"),
    ui_table(
      against_party,
      labels = c(bill = "Bill", title = "Title", vote_date = "Date", vote_desc = "Vote type",
                 vote = "Vote", party_position = "Party position", vote_outcome = "Classification"),
      nowrap = c("bill", "vote_date"),
      empty = "This legislator has not voted against their party."
    )
  )
}
```

## Similar legislators

```{r}
# Links go to career pages in docs/legislators/ (legislators_dir from the
# data partial)
sim_table <- function(type) {
  ui_table(
    leg_similarity |>
      filter(rank_type == type) |>
      arrange(rank) |>
      transmute(
        legislator = map2(filename_b, name_b, \(f, n) a(href = paste0(legislators_dir, f, ".html"), n)),
        party = party_b,
        district = district_b,
        similarity = sprintf("%.1f%%", similarity * 100),
        n_shared
      ),
    labels = c(legislator = "Legislator", party = "Party", district = "District",
               similarity = "Similarity", n_shared = "Shared votes"),
    numeric = c("similarity", "n_shared"),
    nowrap = c("legislator", "district")
  )
}

if (is.null(leg_similarity) || nrow(leg_similarity) == 0) {
  ui_empty("Similarity data is not available yet.")
} else {
  sim_block <- \(title, type) div(class = "g-col-6", h3(title), sim_table(type))
  div(class = "grid",
    sim_block("Most similar overall", "overall"),
    sim_block("Most similar in the other party", "cross_party"),
    sim_block("Least similar overall", "least_overall"),
    sim_block("Least similar in their own party", "least_own_party")
  )
}
```
